Two small lines became three larger lines, increasing actual reading comfort at usage720.
Slogan grew; this competes for space with the practical copy and is a remaining limitation.
Fee/deadline/invitation remain small; their adjacency and date/time/place grouping are retained.
1673×940 changed to 1672×941, now within <=0.5px one-edge rounding tolerance.
Chair, stitched denim and shared hands remain in the same edited boundary relationship; photo surface has been re-rendered slightly but no major contact or content regression is observed.

residuals.description: Fee, deadline, invitation and place remain about 12–13px and smaller than the improved explanation; slogan and date still occupy space that could allow robust practical body.
Native 1672×941 uses permitted half-pixel rounding of exact 16:9 height 940.5; actual dimensions are not mathematically exact 16:9.
